request: A single-player deck-building roguelike like Slay the Spire: you fight a run of increasingly hard enemies one at a time, playing cards from a hand that costs energy, taking damage, and adding new cards to your deck between fights.

A third-person 3D game: you control a character seen from behind in a small outdoor world with ground, scattered buildings and trees, and things to collect. Move with WASD, the camera follows you, and there is a goal to reach.
